title: Create booking form
prompt: Build a form to create a booking: customer reference (text, required), number of containers (whole number, 1 to 99), container type (one of 20GP, 40GP, 40HC, 45HC), and the estimated departure date. Submit and Cancel at the end.

mustNot.why: Use DatePicker, not a native date input
Use Magenta fields, not raw HTML controls

rubric: Container type: 4 options, so Segmented or Radio fits as well as Select (Decision Tree: 2–5 options).
Submit (fill) and Cancel (ghost or outline) are right-aligned at the end of the form.
